purpose: Post-hoc plausibility review of all 19 existing positive atomicity labels; original labels are preserved.
review_method: AI-assisted review against the documented single-feature criterion after the original results were available; not an independent or blinded annotation.
selection_rule: Flag positive atomicity labels where the means primarily enumerates objects, attributes or related terms under one action, without explicitly identifying a second separable operation. Retain the remaining labels for this limited sensitivity analysis, without claiming independent confirmation.
scope: All positive atomicity labels were reviewed. Negative labels were not independently reannotated; this is not a new ground truth.

reviewed_positive_atomicity_labels.reason: Researching requirements and selecting a service are two explicitly requested operations.
Conducting and tracking amendments/studies are explicitly coordinated operations.
Preparing for a hearing and supporting its execution address distinguishable activities.
Conducting a meeting and recording its outcome are explicitly requested operations.
A custom query/report may denote one reporting function; the slash alone does not establish two independently deliverable functions.
Sending and posting citations/fines are explicitly named alternative operations; their distinction still depends on domain interpretation.
Entering a zip code and obtaining a facility list are explicitly linked interaction steps. Their treatment as separate operations follows the existing annotation, not a universal decomposition rule.
Selecting waste types and obtaining facility/opening-hour results are explicitly coordinated before the final benefit clause; the unusual sentence structure remains an interpretive limitation.
Adding and removing facility information are distinguishable operations.
Reading feedback and complaints can be one reading function with two kinds of content.
Checking transaction history and keeping a record are explicitly requested operations.
UI and UX name related quality concepts; the means does not specify two separable functional operations.
Accessing the site and doing other tasks are explicitly coordinated, although the second task is vague and device independence is a separate concern.
Attending UI/UX lessons is one stated activity; the slash in the subject area does not establish two required operations.
One dashboard may display both usage statistics and locations; multiple attributes do not by themselves prove multiple functions.
Browsing a facility list and identifying environmentally friendly facilities are explicitly linked functions under the existing interpretation.
Updating information and accepted material types can be one maintenance function with different fields.
Access to user statistics and schedules can be one access function; extra actions in the benefit do not settle atomicity of the means.
Communicating with the administrator and conveying issues are explicitly coordinated under the existing interpretation, although their functional separation remains domain-dependent.

incomplete_means.reason: The only positive label is not independently confirmed. Notification wish and triggering event are stated; passive wording alone does not establish a missing means. Evaluate the graph alarms qualitatively, not as a validated classifier comparison.
